templates.kvarta: Swiss financial setting. Numbered sections, tabular figures, cool stock. For the board.
templates.prezydia: A dark deck. One idea per slide, large type, full-bleed charts. For showing on screen.
templates.mahistral: A dense operational digest. Mono labels, figures first, minimal air. For daily reading.
templates.chasopys: An analytical read set in a serif, in two columns. Generous leading, deep teal accent. For text that gets read.
templates.minimum: Nothing but air and a strict baseline. Hairline rules, no ornament at all. For people who do not want design.
